text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Saddam Hussein chairs a joint meeting of the Revolutionary Command Council and the regional command of the Baath party. A spokesman said after the meeting the U.N. Security Council's resolutions do not prevent Iraq from using its civilian planes outside the country.
- Washington fails to make the Security Council issue a statement against Iraq on the pilgrims flight.
- Iraq wins an international football cup held in India.
- Saudi papers pay attention to Iraqi pilgrims flight.
- An Iranian intelligence officer exposes Iranian regime's involvement in assassinating opposition figures abroad.
(The above were also carried by JUMHOURIYA and THAWRA)
- National Assembly rejects a bill to impose new taxes on taxi drivers.
- Iraqi pilgrims praise efforts exerted by Saudi Arabia to provide comfort for them.
